caption: The drawing depicts a wooden corner table with two tiers and three slender, curved legs. The table is shown from a frontal angle, occupying the center of the composition against an off-white background that has a faint border drawn around the edge. The table is a reddish-brown color, indicating a polished wood like mahogany, with the top tier having a wavy, scalloped edge and a blue surface set back into the wood, possibly suggesting a fabric or painted insert. The back two edges of the table fit into a 90-degree triangular corner, while the front edge bows outward slightly. The lower tier matches the upper tier in shape without a colored inset, and beneath it are decorative panels or shallow drawers outlined in a lighter brown or gold. The legs extend straight downward from the table’s three corners, curving slightly outward at the base. There is no additional ornamentation or background details besides some scattered spots and marks on the surface outside the table.
title: Corner Wash-stand
